title: Micro and Nanomaterials in Polymers, Ceramics and Metals and Their Advanced Applications
content: The incorporation of micro- and nanomaterials into polymer, ceramic, and metal matrices represents a transformative leap in materials science and engineering [1,9,10] . By leveraging the unique structural, mechanical, and functional properties of fillers at the micro- and nanoscale, advanced composites overcome the inherent limitations of monolithic materials [4,12]. This review examines the synthesis routes, microstructural characterization, and synergistic reinforcement mechanisms of these multi-phase systems, emphasizing their profound impact on modern technological sectors including biomedical engineering, civil infrastructure, and advanced manufacturing [2,3,5].
